title: An Introduction to Introductory Paragraphs
skills: identify the major components of an introductory paragraph
write engaging opening sentences or hooks
develop introductions that lead clearly to a thesis statement
alignment_note: Introduces the structure and purpose of effective introductory paragraphs, including hooks, contextual information, and thesis development. Supports essay organization, academic writing, argument development, and clear transitions into the body of an essay across high school English courses.
